verdicts.reason: A breaks the banner into two panels separated by white gutters and edges. 'фотография' runs into the right edge of the top panel, and a brown blob cuts vertically through the second model's face and glasses. The headline, curator line and CTA do survive in a readable order, but the composition is clearly broken. B is not a layout at all: the headline is missing, decorative circles and blobs are scattered like a sprite sheet on white, the CTA is a tiny half-dome sitting on top of the photo, and the second model is shrunk to a thumbnail. Brand and message are lost, so it is unusable.
